lesson: Match a top container to a ship.
name: First Shift
tip: Tap a stack. Its top box finds the matching ship.

lesson: Parking exposes the useful boxes below.
name: Make Room
tip: No matching ship? A box waits in parking.

lesson: Prepare a full next ship before clearing the berth.
name: Chain Reaction
tip: Park three yellows, then fill a ship.

lesson: Use an open berth before spending parking space.
name: Direct Route

lesson: Use both berths while preparing the next colour.
name: Dockside Flow

lesson: The next colour can be prepared before a berth clears.
name: Next in Line

lesson: Gold is a bonus on the same familiar routing rules.
name: Precious Cargo
tip: Gold cargo pays extra. The sorting rules stay the same.

lesson: Keep one place available while working below a stack.
name: Leave One Free

lesson: Find a useful exit from either of two columns.
name: Two Ways Out

lesson: Introduce the fourth colour without longer stacks.
name: Harbour Rhythm

lesson: A shorter breather that rewards reading the queue.
name: Fresh Tide

lesson: Choose a column that prepares the next two ships.
name: One Step Ahead

lesson: Learn a reveal in a small forgiving layout.
name: Under Wraps
tip: Covered boxes reveal when they reach the top.

lesson: Use the covered-colour counts without gambling.
name: Read the Manifest

lesson: A visible-colour breather before customs.
name: Clear Water

lesson: Clear one ship to open the blocked column.
name: Customs Gate
tip: A padlock opens after the shown number of ships leave.

lesson: Use an unlocked route while the next route opens.
name: Open the Channel

lesson: Sequence two customs releases with different thresholds.
name: Two Gates

lesson: Combine one reveal with one predictable release.
name: Ahead of the Tide

lesson: Put parking, preparation, reveals and customs together.
name: Harbour Master
